original_test_intent: Measure five-minute RDMA write bandwidth over each designated BlueField InfiniBand port and verify specification-level throughput without CRC/link or system-health regressions.
original_method: Identify BlueField host/DPU endpoint, HCA, port, netdev/representor mapping, GID/LID, peer and fabric path; record firmware/DOCA/OFED/perftest/link/MTU and authoritative pre-counters/logs; isolate the path; start the approved ib_write_bw server on one endpoint and client on the other with explicit address/device/port/profile for300 seconds; preserve complete results and health telemetry; repeat each approved port only after a fresh baseline; stop processes, restore settings and compare counter deltas and throughput to versioned thresholds.
manual_activity: IB/DPU owners designate endpoints, HCA/ports, peer/fabric, profile, authoritative counters and thresholds; agent may execute the approved per-port run and collect evidence.
required_inputs: Host/DPU endpoint, BlueField model, HCA/device/port, representor/netdev, GID/LID and peer mapping
Firmware/DOCA/OFED/mlx5/perftest versions, link rate/width/MTU and production-safe fabric isolation
Approved ib_write_bw server/client roles, address, message size, queue depth, connection mode, port and300-second profile
Versioned per-port bandwidth and CRC/link/error thresholds plus thermal/CPU/system-health limits
Counter authority/mapping, port iteration order, abort and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated or explicitly approved IB fabric and peer/DPU-owner approval
Prove stressed IB port and counter mapping before traffic
Use authenticated access and explicit PIDs; never infer HCA/port/peer
Stop on wrong route, link flap, CRC/error storm, production impact, DPU/peer instability or thermal/CPU limit
No automatic retry; restore temporary affinity/firewall/fabric settings and verify both endpoints
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, packages/profile and baseline IB counters/logs
Start approved server/client and collect complete per-port throughput and telemetry
Stop test processes and compare final counters/health
Do not choose topology/profile/spec, substitute Ethernet counters, alter production fabric independently, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve perftest profile and authoritative IB counters
Provide throughput/error/system-health thresholds and isolation/abort policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: `ib_write_bw -d mlx5_0 -t 300` lacks explicit peer/server-client context, may use incorrect option semantics, truncates output and checks an unproven ethX counter through insecure SSH.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the installed perftest version's validated server invocation on the approved endpoint, then the matching client invocation with explicit peer, device and port for300 seconds; capture full client/server output plus `ibstat`/`ibv_devinfo` and authoritative pre/post `perfquery`/`ibqueryerrors` or vendor-equivalent counters.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five-minute ib_write_bw duration, before/after error checks, repeat across approved ports and bandwidth/system-health criteria are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run topology-bound per-port RDMA write tests with complete endpoint and authoritative fabric-health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit endpoint roles, HCA/port/GID mapping, perftest profile, authoritative counters and controlled cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ethX grep and tail cannot prove the stressed IB port, complete throughput or absence of fabric errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BlueField host-versus-Arm placement, GID/transport mode, MTU, queue/message profile and PCIe/NUMA path materially change performance.

project_override_considerations: Decide whether the test targets BlueField Arm-side HCA, host PF/VF/representor or an external port and whether Ethernet counters are actually mapped to it. Do not silently choose mlx5_0, RoCE/IB mode, GID, peer or performance threshold.
expected_evidence: Exact server/client commands and complete300-second per-port results
Authoritative pre/post IB CRC/link/error counters and deltas
DPU/host/peer logs, CPU/thermal/link telemetry, timestamps and restored health
Versioned threshold comparison and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests five-minute ib_write_bw per port with pre/post error checks. Missing endpoint syntax, port mapping and thresholds are input gaps rather than contradictory intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A compatible peer, toolchain, topology/profile and thresholds can be supplied; the static test intent remains identifiable.

review_improvement: Converts an incomplete device-only command and ambiguous ethX check into a topology-bound, per-port IB benchmark with authoritative counter provenance and complete evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: RDMA bandwidth depends on both endpoints, fabric route, transport/GID mode, message/queue parameters, NUMA placement and negotiated link. BlueField exposes multiple host, DPU and representor identities, so mlx5_0 or ethX cannot be assumed to name the stressed external port. Only a full paired run and mapped pre/post IB counters can distinguish genuine throughput from the wrong path or a run accompanied by link errors.
